description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the greenhouse, a bigger stage: a longer glass house on curved wooden ribs over a low grey stone base, inside rows of green herb beds with white, yellow and purple flowers and small potted plants on shelves, a watering can and a wooden water barrel by the door, the glass panes catching the light

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
